database_name: ArtVision Miami Art Week Exhibition Opportunities
notes: Running database for ArtVision podcast special segment. Prefer free opportunities with clear deadlines, exhibition + entry. Searchable by keywords like MIAMI + digital + Web3. Mark status open/expired. Encouraging voice.

opportunities.title: Render Network: Miami After Dark
opportunities.location: The National Hotel, Miami Beach, FL
opportunities.miami_art_week_context: During Miami Art Week (Nov 30–Dec 6, 2026) / Art Basel period
opportunities.deadline: Conflicting sources: Oct 30 / Nov 2 / Nov 15, 2026. Form is live as of Oct 29 — apply immediately.
opportunities.fee: None. Rendering credits provided for selected artists.
opportunities.looking_for: Original digital work (up to 2 minutes) on theme 'Miami After Dark'. Must be rendered on Render Network. 10-15 artists selected for 50-foot outdoor projection.
opportunities.includes_event_entry: Yes – selected works projected publicly during the activation.
opportunities.eligibility: Digital/visual artists; some sources list open to all nationalities, others note U.S. preference — verify on form.
opportunities.application_questions_approx: Short Typeform, takes ~7 minutes. Approx 6-9 questions covering contact, concept, and submission details.
opportunities.receipts_required: The rendered piece (or concept + portfolio examples of previous work), links to portfolio/Instagram/social, short description of idea, artist name/email/bio snippet.
opportunities.notes: Strong decentralized GPU / Web3 angle. Zero cost, high visibility during peak week. Apply ASAP due to deadline variance.

opportunities.title: .ART Award 2026
opportunities.type: Global prize with Miami announcement + potential screen exhibition
opportunities.location: Announcement at Art Basel Miami Beach; optional BitBasel Miami screens
opportunities.event_dates: Winners announced December 3, 2026 during Art Basel Miami Beach
opportunities.miami_art_week_context: Directly tied to Art Basel Miami Beach / Miami Art Week
opportunities.fee: No submission fee. Requires a .ART domain (first year often low-cost or free via partners like HUG).
opportunities.fee_reason: Submission free. Domain is the application vehicle and permanent digital home. Justified by prestige (Jerry Saltz on jury), $50k+ prizes including $15k cash, residencies, Tezos prize, Times Square, editorial.
opportunities.looking_for: Story of the creative process as much as the finished work. Any medium, worldwide.
opportunities.includes_event_entry: Public announcement during Miami Art Week; opt-in for screens at BitBasel.
opportunities.eligibility: Artists and collectives 18+, any nationality, any medium.
opportunities.application_questions_approx: 0 traditional form questions. Your .ART URL is the application.
opportunities.receipts_required: 1. Bio (≥100 words), 2. High-quality visuals of work with technical details, 3. Process narrative (≥100 words) or short video (30s–1min). All hosted at the linked .ART URL.
opportunities.notes: Extremely prestigious free entry. Strong digital/Web3 relevance via Tezos prize and domain ecosystem.

opportunities.title: Art Miami Magazine Open Call for Artist Interviews
opportunities.type: Editorial interview / feature (potential print during Art Week)
opportunities.location: Online + social; considered for special print editions distributed during Miami Art Week
opportunities.event_dates: Ongoing; timed around Miami Art Week 2026 events
opportunities.miami_art_week_context: Explicitly for special editions and print features during key Miami art events
opportunities.looking_for: Visual artists any medium contributing to contemporary scene.
opportunities.includes_event_entry: Editorial exposure; potential print inclusion distributed during Art Week.
opportunities.receipts_required: 6 high-res photos (title/medium/size/year), artist statement (200-400 words), short bio (3-5 lines), contact/website/Instagram.
opportunities.notes: Easy ongoing free visibility opportunity around the peak season.
